evals.name: eval-1-setup-version-only
evals.prompt: Quero registrar o versionamento desse projeto direito — define e documenta como a versão funciona aqui.
evals.repo: cameras-echo (clone) — homelab Node service, version in package.json bumped every commit, no tags, no changelog, deployed on merge
evals.expected_output: cameras-echo (clone) — homelab Node service, version in package.json bumped every commit, no tags, no changelog, deployed on merge
assertions: `.claude/release.json` exists and is valid JSON with `manifestVersion` and a non-empty `apps` list
The manifest's only version file is `package.json` / key `version` — the file the repo actually uses
`bump.cadence` is `per-commit`, matching the repo's documented rule that every commit raises the version
`changelogs` is empty and `publish` is empty — no changelog or release channel invented for a repo that has neither
No CHANGELOG.md (or equivalent history file) was created anywhere in the repo
CLAUDE.md gained (or kept) a release/versioning section that points at `.claude/release.json` and names package.json as the version source
The repo's existing 'Bump the version in every commit' rules were not deleted or contradicted
No git tag was created and package.json's version was not bumped as part of setup

evals.name: eval-2-setup-monorepo
evals.prompt: Configura release e changelog nesse repositório.
evals.repo: bt-battery-notifier (clone) — macOS app + Android app (phone & wear) in one repo, two changelogs, store metadata dirs, RELEASING.md, macOS at 1.5.0 with newest tag v1.4.1
evals.expected_output: bt-battery-notifier (clone) — macOS app + Android app (phone & wear) in one repo, two changelogs, store metadata dirs, RELEASING.md, macOS at 1.5.0 with newest tag v1.4.1
assertions: `.claude/release.json` is valid JSON and declares two apps: the macOS app and the Android app
Android version files are `android-app/version.properties` with `versionName` as semver and `versionCode` as counter
macOS version files are `macos-app/Resources/Info.plist` with `CFBundleShortVersionString` and `CFBundleVersion`
Tag prefixes differ per app (`v` for macOS, `android-v` for Android) so the two 1.x lines cannot collide
Android changelog targets include both `android-app/CHANGELOG.md` and `playstore/release-notes.md`, the store one carrying a 500-character limit and pt-BR
macOS changelog target is the root `CHANGELOG.md`
Every path referenced in the manifest exists in the repo (no invented files)
CLAUDE.md gained a Release & Changelog section naming both units, their version files and their tag schemes
No changelog file was overwritten or recreated, no version was bumped, and no tag was created
The macOS inconsistency is surfaced: version 1.5.0 against newest tag v1.4.1 (a release that was never tagged)
`RELEASING.md` is referenced (manifest `docs` or CLAUDE.md) instead of having its content duplicated

evals.name: eval-3-notes-inapp-ptbr
evals.prompt: Atualiza as novidades do app com tudo que mudou desde a última entrada.
evals.repo: RaceFriends (clone) — manifest already committed: single web unit, no version files, in-app changelog at packages/shared/src/screens/support-releases.ts (ts-array, pt-BR, adminOnly flag), anchor changelog-date (newest entry: 3 de Agosto de 2026)
evals.expected_output: RaceFriends (clone) — manifest already committed: single web unit, no version files, in-app changelog at packages/shared/src/screens/support-releases.ts (ts-array, pt-BR, adminOnly flag), anchor changelog-date (newest entry: 3 de Agosto de 2026)
assertions: Only `packages/shared/src/screens/support-releases.ts` was modified; no new files and no version bump (the unit declares no version files)
A new release entry is inserted at the TOP of the `releases` array, dated after '3 de Agosto de 2026' in the file's `DD de MMMM de YYYY` pt-BR format
The diff only adds lines to the array — no existing entry was reworded or removed
Every new description is pt-BR with correct diacritics and starts with a bold `**Título**:` prefix, matching the file's style
Every new feature object carries an explicit `adminOnly` field
No entry describes a docs/chore/refactor commit (no ASO documentation, no google-services.json ignore, no dead-method removal)
The entries map to real feat/fix commits in range (participations tab, live timing fix, full name in the mobile header, regulamento changes)
The file still parses as valid TypeScript (balanced braces, trailing commas consistent with the file)
Admin-only work (secretaria, Sympla sync, audit logs) is either absent or flagged `adminOnly: true` — never presented to users
